`Test UI (2/16)` failed on `472a4e66` in `ui/scripts/__tests__/doc-version-claims.test.ts`. The test reported "implausibly few node-version declarations … expected 1 to be greater than or equal to 15". That failure does not come from this PR:

- This PR changes only `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` (`ObjectView.tsx` and two new sibling modules) plus a changeset. It touches no workflow and nothing the test reads.
- PR CI runs on the merge with current `main`. `main` had just taken #26419, which moved the `setup-node` steps into a composite action and left one `node-version:` line under `.github/workflows`. The test's fix landed separately as #26432: it anchors CI's Node on `.nvmrc` as well.

I merged `main` (`67461403`, which carries #26432) into the branch, with no force-push. The new head is `d5ff0d23`. On that head the test passes locally, 29/29. The merge brings no change under `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/` or `layout/`. CI re-runs on the push.
